name: 蕭耀榮
objective: This course introduces the fundamental principles and basic applications of Artificial Intelligence (AI) Deep Learning (DL), and the theory and practical implementation of intelligent fuzzy control. The course combines theory and practice to make students understand AI DL, intelligent control, and their applications.
課程進度(1-16週):
Week 1: Introduction to Artificial Intelligence and Fuzzy Control
Week 2: Review of control system dynamics
Week 3: Fuzzy sets / Fuzzy relations / Fuzzy operation
Week 4: Legal holiday
Week 5: workshop I/II - membership function  Fuzzy control simulation
Week 6: Fuzzy implications
Week 7: Fuzzy logic control
Week 7: Fuzzy controller design
Week 8: Legal holiday
Week 9: Fuzzy controller design
Week 10: Legal holiday
Week 11: Writing Exam
Week 12: Introduction to Deep Learning and Machine Learning
Week 13: Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) and CNN model
Week 14: Image Preprocessing, Deep Learning Model Adjustment
Week 15: Deep Learning and Image Recognition
Week 16: project presentation and demonstration
wk17-18  auxiliary learning
彈性學習(17-18週):
類別
		  
		    ● 學生分組實作及討論 (Student group practice and discussion)
● AI 輔助學習與工具應用 (AI-assisted learning and tool application)
		  
      

      
        內容
        
          Students have extended study about Fuzzy control or AI Deep Learning.

延伸教學與資源: ● 參與式創新教學 (Participatory & Innovative Teaching) 強調學生參與與產出，導入翻轉、PBL/專題、設計思考或遊戲化等策略。Emphasizes student engagement and outcomes by adopting strategies such as Flipped Classroom, PBL (Problem/Project- Based Learning), Design Thinking, or Gamification.● 數位科技融入 (Digital Technology Integration) 運用生成式 AI、VR/AR、IoT、IRS 等新興科技輔助教學與評量。Utilizes emerging technologies such as Generative AI, VR/AR, IoT, and IRS (Interactive Response Systems) to facilitate teaching and assessment.
課程對應SDGs指標: SDG4：優質教育（Quality Education）SDG9：產業創新與基礎設施（Industry, Innovation and Infrastructure）
課程是否導入AI: ● 使用生成式 AI 作為教學過程的輔助工具（Use generative AI tools as an aid to the teaching process）● 鼓勵學生使用生成式 AI 工具（Encourage students to use generative AI tools）● 簡單介紹 AI 的基本概念（Briefly introduce the basic concept of AI）● 深入探討 AI 的原理與應用（Explore the principles and applications of AI in depth）
remarks: In the weeks of auxiliary learning, self-learning for students is performed, and no scoring for this performance.
